name: CodePen

sources.title: CodePen documentation index — pens, collections, profile features, PRO tiers, topics/challenges
Batch-provided signup URL — codepen.io returns 403 to non-browser fetchers

requirements: Free account creation at codepen.io/accounts/signup (codepen.io blocks non-browser fetchers with 403 — use a real browser)
This is a front-end playground/community, not a directory: the 'listing' is a public profile plus published Pens
Value comes from a completed profile (display name, bio, website link) and real public Pens — empty profiles carry little weight
Email verification is a documented step (see 'Email Verification' doc)
preparation: Username (check CodePen's Inactive Username Policy if reclaiming a name), email, display name
At least one polished demo Pen showcasing the product's UI/interaction — 'Picked Pens' are curated by staff for homepage exposure
Relevant tags for the Pens (CodePen supports tags and topics pages)
workflow: Sign up at https://codepen.io/accounts/signup in a browser (page 403s for automated fetches)
Complete the profile: website link, bio, avatar
Create and publish one or more public Pens demonstrating the product's front-end
Tag Pens and organize into Collections; optionally join Challenges/Topics for discovery
watchFor: codepen.io hard-blocks automated fetches (403 on homepage and signup) — cannot verify current signup form fields; docs at blog.codepen.io are accessible
'Picked Pens' editorial selection is curated, not submittable — don't assume homepage placement
PRO tier adds privacy/asset hosting but is not needed for a public profile backlink
Private Pens require PRO — keep showcase Pens public
countsAsLive: The public profile at codepen.io/<username> renders with a website link and at least one published public Pen
unknowns: Whether profile website links are followed or nofollow
Current signup form specifics (OAuth options, CAPTCHA) — page not fetchable
